items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Speaking of Jimmy Talbert, I've known him since he was...I guess he was still a teenager. Anyhow, our lives

ctx.x: It seems as though if Eddie Beal and Jimmy Talbert had something to do with it, I would have been there. Because our lives have seemed to criss-cross most of my life, really.
